name: CheeseSchedule
tagline: 教室大屏的电子课表：多周轮换、桌面小组件、随机抽选一应俱全
taglineEn: Electronic timetable for classroom displays: multi-week rotation, widgets and random picking
description: 奶酪课程表是一款简洁的教室大屏电子课表软件，基于 Tauri + Vue 开发，安装包不到 10 MB、内存占用约 150 MB，比同类软件轻得多。除了课表本身（时间模式与课程编辑、多周轮换、按天自动切换、当日临时换课、时间偏移），它还把教室里常用的功能整合了进来：上下课语音提醒、窗口按上下课自动置顶置底；桌面可摆时钟、倒计日、日期进度、每日单词等小组件；随机抽选支持快捷键与悬浮按钮触发、动态概率、防重复、排除请假者。另有 CSES 通用课程表格式导入导出、编辑器密码锁定、U 盘密钥解锁等。注意：无法在 Windows 7 上运行，需要 Windows 10/11。
descriptionEn: CheeseSchedule is a clean timetable app for classroom displays, built with Tauri + Vue. The installer is under 10 MB and memory use is about 150 MB, much lighter than similar tools. Beyond timetables (time and course editing, multi-week rotation, automatic daily switching, temporary swaps, time offsets), it bundles classroom utilities: voice reminders for class start and end, automatic always-on-top/bottom windows, desktop widgets for clock, countdowns, date progress and a word of the day, plus random picking with hotkeys, floating buttons, dynamic probability, no repeats and absence exclusion. It also supports CSES timetable import/export, editor password lock and USB-key unlock. Note: it requires Windows 10/11 and does not run on Windows 7.
author: xwzkj
